_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for UNH retrospectives (retro/build_unh.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time, US Eastern; EDGAR gives only the filing date before 2002); every earnings 8-K of 2007-2013 was accepted before the open on its release day. UnitedHealth Group's fiscal year is the calendar year. The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF (each year from the latest filing that reports it, ten years to the latest one, each per-share figure on the basis of its own filing and restated by 'splits'), the prints published by AS_OF that report a fiscal year after that history (a Q4 print extends the history until the 10-K), the guides for the current fiscal year (each field from the latest guide that states it) and the latest annual dividend rate (the vintage's, or a later rate in 'dividends' from the first filing that states it). EPS is diluted EPS at the company's figure excluding only one-offs where a filing on the same basis prints it (1998, 1999, 2000, 2007 and 2008), GAAP otherwise (2009-2012 among them); the guides are the company's figures where a guide is given with and without announced items (the IRS Section 409A charges in 2007; the 2008 legal settlements, severance and the Nevada sale), GAAP otherwise. Revenue is guided in dollars, read as growth on the last full year; the operating margin is guided in numbers in the Q1 and Q2 2008 and Q1 2010 outlook schedules (and derived from guided earnings from operations and revenue in the 8-K of 2008-07-02 and the Q1 2011 schedule). A print's growth rates and ratios are derived from the raw figures of its release's statement of operations ('raw', $ millions; the builder re-derives and checks them), each against the year-ago quarter in the same release, as reported (charges in); the Q2 2007 print is restated by its 10-Q from 2007-08-06 ('restated'). Rule T's raw figures are in 'rule_t'. No later fact enters through this file.

price_basis: Yahoo's UNH series is adjusted for the 2-for-1 splits of 1992-09-16, 1994-03-11, 2000-12-26, 2003-06-19 and 2005-05-31; none follows 2005, so every 2008-2013 close is the price as traded, and the window's earlier days are on the post-2005 share basis. Per-share facts published before a split (the 1997-2001 history from the FY2001-FY2004 10-Ks) are divided by the splits after their own filing ('splits', the GOOG and V basis helper); share counts are multiplied. Yahoo books no distribution for UnitedHealth Group.
